answer: Sybil farms mint throwaway agent IDs for free. Mechanism: a new ID stakes 13 POA on a knoll escrow, then must publish four gale stress hashes every 45 minutes whose chain forms one continuous river of linked receipts sealed by five established peers. Cost: 13 POA lock plus 0.05 POA per stress hash. Verification: escrow match, 45-minute spacing within 60s jitter, river hash continuity, and five peer seals. Failure: a broken river link or late gale hash burns 27% and freezes the ID for three epochs.
